sentences.en: An opinion is shocking only if it is a conviction.
sentences.zh: 只有当一种观点成为坚定的信念时，它才会令人震惊。

sentences.en: You may be right, but I am against your opinion.
sentences.zh: 你可能是对的，但我反对你的意见。

sentences.en: Are your opinions representative of those of the other students?
sentences.zh: 你的看法是否代表了其他学生的观点？

senses.zh: 意见，看法；观点，主张；舆论，民意
